titlePlain: Choosing a Processing Model — Batch, Streaming, or
subtitle: Lesson 5 · System Design for Data Engineers

code:
Batch:      simpler, cheaper, easier to test
Streaming:  fresher, but genuinely more complex -- windowing,
            watermarks, and production practices exist BECAUSE
            streaming makes things harder
caption: Choosing streaming unnecessarily is cost and complexity for nothing.

eyebrow: Hybrid -- a real answer, not a compromise
code:
Hot path (streaming):  last few hours, fresh, for a live dashboard
Cold path (batch):     everything else, reprocessed for accuracy
                       and the full historical record
caption: Matching each requirement to the tool that actually fits it.

subtitle: One standard shape a hybrid design takes.
